name: imposter-app
description: A pass-and-play vocabulary-building bluffing game. One player is secretly given a different word or number to everyone else, and has to bluff their way through a clue round without getting caught. 11+ vocabulary is the default theme (closest to genuinely educational), but it's built to be family fun first — the other themes (animals, food, countries, movies, numbers) stay just as prominent for players who want pure play over the vocabulary angle.
